title: Bluecon: reading historical data older than 20 minutes ago
symptom: When going for runs without the phone, upon return only the previous four readings are available, not the historical data from during the run.
cause: The Bluekon.java code limits m_minutesBack to 15 whenever the value is over 17, preventing retrieval of older historical data.
fix: Use the LibreOOPAlgorithm extension as suggested by tzachi-dar, which provides 8 hours of data and results close to the Libre reader.
evidence_quote: There is one simple advice to get the 8 hours data: Follow this page: https://github.com/tzachi-dar/LibreOOPAlgorithm
